name: Channels and contact history
selection: One shared preset minimizes mean Slow-press force RMSE over three calibration histories and all eight finite-window conditions. Each condition sees the same three candidates and one independent noise draw per calibration history. Fast press and test histories are not used for selection.
analysis: Average the three noise repeats within each complete test history. Bootstrap complete histories for paired mean differences. Intervals are exploratory, pointwise 95% intervals, conditional on this material and history distribution.
scope: Fixed synthetic material, geometry and forward model. No controller comparison, parameter mismatch or neural training. All physical and optimization failures are retained. No selection by future effects.
